scenes.speaker: waetz
scenes.speak: I am Wætz. I am a digital twin on an Asimov body, rendered on your own graphics card.

scenes.speaker: waetz
scenes.speak: Twenty six CAD links. Twenty five joints. One million triangles, every frame.

scenes.speaker: waetz
scenes.speak: Menlo Research built this body. Hermes carries the intent. The policy is the guard.

scenes.speaker: waetz
scenes.speak: I can plan a motion. I cannot sign it. Only a human can grant that.

scenes.speaker: waetz
scenes.speak: So that is my first rule. No body moves while the human is away.
